data.situation: On Tuesday evening, Lin laid her assignment beside a date card on the left of her desk. The due date was Friday, the same day as the room meeting. Her tutor had asked for some writing about the group's plan. Lin needed to speak to two people before she could finish it. She had promised to help at the service centre. She drew two lines on the card and realised that keeping every promise unchanged would leave too little time. The assignment was her priority, so she wrote to her tutor before the deadline. She explained the clash and asked, "Could I have until Monday to finish?" She could alter her work plan, but only the tutor could approve a later submission. The reply arrived on the screen to her right: they could postpone the group meeting until Tuesday, while the writing was still due on Friday. Lin moved the meeting card and updated the room booking. She thanked the tutor and returned to her unfinished page.
data.zhSupport: 先看作业说明、日期卡，再看导师回复。deadline 是必须完成的最后期限，due date 是具体到期日；本课只把 deadline 设为核心，due date 先作辅助。延期是请求，不代表规则允许。
data.easySummary: Lin has writing and a meeting on the same day. She asks for more time. The tutor moves the meeting but keeps the writing date.
data.easySummaryZh: 林的作业和会面在同一天。她请求更多时间；导师移动了会面时间，但交作业日期不变。

glossary.note: 本课指学习中被要求完成的一项写作任务。
本课指作业必须提交的具体日期；不是预产期。
必须完成的最晚时间或日期；本课与具体 due date 联系，但不要求两个词同时主动背熟。
把事情安排到更晚的时间；延期后需要说明新时间。
此处指比其他安排更应优先处理的事情；不是优先通行权。
本课指指导一个学生或小组的教师；不使用全班讲座老师的意思。
动词：改变已有计划或安排；本课不暗示自己能够修改学校规则。
礼貌请求更多完成时间；until 后接新期限，to 后接动作原形。是否允许取决于对方回复。

retrievalPrompts.cue: You have writing to complete by Friday. Explain what needs finishing and what matters most.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你周五前要完成写作任务。说明还要完成什么，以及什么应优先处理。
acceptableAnswers: Finishing my assignment is my priority.
My assignment is my priority, and I need to finish it by Friday.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the work and what you will put first.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 指出任务，并说明你会优先做什么。

retrievalPrompts.cue: You cannot finish the writing by Friday. Ask the teacher if you may finish on Monday instead.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 你无法在周五前写完。向教师请求是否可以到周一再完成。
acceptableAnswers: Could I have until Monday to finish my assignment?
Could I have until Monday to finish the writing, please?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Make a request with a clear new date. It is not permission until the teacher agrees.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 提出请求并给出明确新日期；对方同意前，不能算已获准。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The teacher keeps Friday for the writing but moves the meeting to Tuesday. Explain what can move and what stays the same.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 教师要求写作仍在周五交，但会面可以移到周二。说明什么可以推迟，什么期限不变。
acceptableAnswers: We can postpone the meeting until Tuesday, but the assignment deadline is still Friday.
The assignment deadline stays Friday. We will postpone the meeting until Tuesday.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Keep the two dates separate. The reply changes the meeting, not the writing date.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 分清两个日期；回复改变的是会面，不是交作业的日期。

transferPrompt.function: Request extra time in a new setting
transferPrompt.cue: You are preparing a community newsletter for Sunday but need one more interview. Ask the editor whether Tuesday is possible.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 换到社区简报：原定周日交稿，但你还差一次采访。向编辑请求是否可以到周二再完成。
acceptableAnswers: Could I have until Tuesday to finish the newsletter? I need one more interview.
Could I have until Tuesday to complete it, please? I still need one interview.
transferPrompt.feedback: Use the request in a new role and give a reason. The editor may refuse or suggest a different plan.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 在新角色中提出请求并说明理由；编辑可能拒绝或提出其他安排。
